content_sections.heading: MANUU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the MANUU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download MANUU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Lecturer (Civil Engineering) and 1 for Lecturer (Mechanical Engineering).

content_sections.heading: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Lecturer (Civil Engineering): B.E./B.Tech./B.S. in Civil Engineering with First Class or equivalent. Preference to M.E./M.Tech. Knowledge of Urdu required. Lecturer (Mechanical Engineering): B.E./B.Tech./B.S. in Mechanical Engineering with First Class or equivalent. Preference to M.E./M.Tech. Knowledge of Urdu required.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MANUU Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview scheduled for 13 August 2026. There is no online application deadline; candidates must attend the interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech./B.S. in the relevant engineering discipline with First Class or equivalent. A knowledge of Urdu is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Are there any application fees for MANUU Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Maulana Azad National Urdu University, Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, 516004.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for the Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any age-related criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: The Lecturer positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Lecturer positions, with one each for Civil Engineering and Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q10. Is knowledge of Urdu a mandatory requirement?
faq.answer: Yes, knowledge of Urdu is a mandatory requirement for all Lecturer positions advertised by MANUU in this recruitment.
